name: Insider Threat
summary: Confirmed or strongly suspected malicious / negligent behaviour by an authenticated insider. Covers data theft prior to departure, sabotage, and policy-violating access.

steps.title: Confirm insider-threat program + HR liaison
steps.description: Verify the cross-functional team is on call: HR, legal, physical security, insider-program lead. Confirm escalation thresholds and consent-to-monitor language.

steps.title: Confirm UEBA baselines are current
steps.description: Make sure UEBA baselines for the affected user / department are within the freshness window and that the high-risk-user watch-list is reviewed monthly.

steps.title: Triage insider signal
steps.description: Confirm signal validity. Pull UEBA anomalies, DLP matches, badge data, VPN logs. Distinguish negligence vs intent.

steps.title: Engage HR + legal for context
steps.description: Loop in HR + legal under privilege. Check for active performance plans, recent resignation, or known disputes that change the response posture.

steps.title: Uplift monitoring on the actor (with approval)
steps.description: Under documented legal approval, enable targeted monitoring (endpoint, mail, removable media). Capture evidence under chain-of-custody.

steps.title: Reduce privilege without tipping off
steps.description: Where possible, silently reduce access to crown-jewel datasets (just-in-time, time-bound) while preserving day-to-day workflow so the actor is not alerted.

steps.title: Revoke all access at HR trigger
steps.description: At the HR-coordinated trigger (termination, suspension), revoke physical badge, VPN, all SSO entitlements, mail forwarders, and API tokens.

steps.title: Recover any exfiltrated data
steps.description: Issue takedown requests, leverage cloud-storage retention holds, and work with legal to recover or destroy any data the insider exfiltrated.

steps.title: Update insider-threat program
steps.description: Translate the case into program updates: training, UEBA tuning, joiner/mover/leaver hardening. Add a red-team scenario covering the TTPs observed.

steps.title: Conduct after-action review under privilege
steps.description: Hold a blameless retro under legal privilege. Capture timeline, decisions, and gaps. Track follow-ups to closure.
